whenToUse: Creating a new account with an email.
You want to prevent duplicate sign-ups early.
whenNotToUse: There are so many fields they should be split into steps (use a multi-step form).
A social account is enough (use social sign-in).
People could look around before signing up.

alternatives.name: Password Strength Meter
alternatives.reason: Showing password strength as a bar.

alternatives.name: Terms Agreement
alternatives.reason: Getting consent to terms before sign-up.

accessibility: Tie the rules list to the password field with aria-describedby so it's read.
Each rule says whether it's met in words, not color.
The duplicate email notice is read via aria-live.
